notes.title: Progression Update 1.1 & Idler Fest!
notes.notes:
Hello new and returning dwarf idlers! It's 2025 and I hope everyone had an amazing holiday and start to the New Year! Progression Update 1.1 will focus on new type of progression system and more of a even better user-friendly experience. Dwarves Mining Idle is 50% off during the Idler Fest event.

Dwarves Mining Idle didn't have any progression information or information regarding what you had unlocked and in turn most players didn't know what to do or look at. Recipes were already unlocked and players kind of had no clue what recipes you had either besides going to an unlocked placeable (Furnace, etc).

We've had some feedback on our UI, seems most players still couldn't grasp it. Seeing how players still had issues with this, we've taken the liberty to remove all the buttons on the UI and put them all into one button (Game Menu) and one window using a tab system. Each one of these tabs are now locked and are unlocked with progression. This way you will KNOW what each tab represents and what it does after unlocking a new tab in the Game Menu. Previously, all the buttons were thrown at you without any type of unlock progression and I feel like this made it more difficult for players since they didn't want to go through and read what each button brought them too.

[h1]Contact[/h1]
For interaction with Litty Game developers and our community please join our [url=https://discord.com/invite/R5NkCDu6Uy]Discord[/url]. We're open to constructive criticism, feedback and suggestions for our games and we find it very important to hear our community out! Please report as much as you can on Discord or our community forum! If you want to hangout on Discord or view upcoming projects, you're more than welcome to!

If you don't have Discord, you can post your suggestions in the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2220570/discussions/4/]Suggestions Forum[/url].

[h1]Patch Notes[/h1]
[list]
[h2]Progression Update 1.1[/h2]
[*] Slightly reworked the guide for the new update. Also made the guide more user-friendly, easier to read and follow. Added a new part to the guide that you can access by going to Menu -> Settings -> Guide.
[*] Added Dwarf King Perk tree. This is a special perk tree that allows you to spend Obsidian you obtain from completing challenges to upgrade specific perks for some long-term beneficial stats!
[*] Added Challenges. Completing a challenge will reward you with Obsidian and you can spend Obsidian in the new Dwarf King Perk tree.
[*] Added Daily Challenges. The daily timer shares with the store timer that way they both reset at the same time.
[*] Added over 250+ Challenges.
[*] Removed and cleaned up all buttons in the UI (Dwarves, Floors, etc) and replaced it with one Game Menu button that brings up every removed button using a tab system.
[*] Added new button: Game Menu. This button is more noticeable (it's bigger and the only button to bring up the Game Menu).
[*] Added new button artwork for the Game Menu window. These new buttons should be more noticeable on what the tab is.
[*] Offline progression was changed with the new progression system.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43209080/3e03c2e2bf0acba7eb6433275c6abd9b65ae3326.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43209080/4a21e445b6d0523fa358e5a034df9032e36026d9.png[/img]
[/list]
[list]
[h2]Achievements[/h2]
With the new update comes more achievements to, well, achieve!
[*] Added new achievement icons on Steam!
[*] Added new achievement: Smelting Artisan: Unlock all Furnace Recipes.
[*] Added new achievement: Crusher Artisan:  Unlock all Crusher Recipes.
[*] Added new achievement: Stamping Artisan:  Unlock all Stamper Recipes.
[*] Added new achievement: Fusion Artisan:  Unlock all Fusion Machine Recipes.
[*] Added new achievement: General Challenger: Complete all General Challenges.
[*] Added new achievement: Daily Challenger: Complete 5 Daily Challenges.
[*] Added new achievement: Dwarf Challenger: Complete all Dwarf Challenges.
[*] Added new achievement: Machine Challenger: Complete all Machine Challenges.
[*] Added new achievement: Mining Challenger: Complete all Mining Challenges.
[*] Added new achievement: Combat Challenger: Complete all Combat Challenges.
[*] Added new achievement: Liquid Challenger: Complete all Liquid Challenges.
[*] Added new achievement: The Surface Challenger: Complete all The Surface Challenges.
[*] Added new achievement: Ultimate Challenger: Complete all Challenges.
[/list]
[list]
[h2]Progression[/h2]
Each tab that was once a button in the UI is now locked and can be unlocked through progression.
[*] Floors Tab: Unlock by purchasing your second floor.
[*] Dwarven Book: Unlock by purchasing 3 Dwarves.
[*] Archaeology: Unlock by cloning a Dwarf 5 times.
[*] Store Tab: Unlock by completing 100 Challenges.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43209080/cf1127a149a83b08486fa78e4cc5bf7a3474c981.png[/img]
[/list]
[list]
[h2]Floor Conversion Progression[/h2]
Before converting floors to Combat or Liquid you now have to unlock Combat and Liquid.
[*] Combat: Unlocks after purchasing your second floor.
[*] Liquid: Unlocks after defeating 100 Slimes.
[/list]
[list]
[h2]Ore Progression[/h2]
Back when early development ores were locked to an area number. I wanted an idea on how to go about this without including area number and I decided to lock ore behind progression. This will allow you to know the ores in the game and what's available to you.
[*] Dirt: Unlocked by default.
[*] Stone: Unlocked by default.
[*] Sand: Mine 1000 Dirt and 500 Stone to unlock.
[*] Mud: Mine 250 Sand to unlock.
[*] Coal: Mine 50 Dirt and 25 Stone to unlock.
[*] Copper Ore: Mine 100 Coal to unlock.
[*] Gold Ore: Mine 250 Copper Ore to unlock.
[*] Diamond: Mine 100 Gold Ore to unlock.
[*] Uranium Ore: Mine 500 Diamond to unlock.
[/list]
[list]
[h2]Enemy Progression[/h2]
You now have to unlock new enemies by eliminating available enemies. Dumb Goblin and Angry Goblin drops more loot.
[*] Dumb Goblin: Slay 100 Slimes.
[*] Angry Goblin: Slay 1000 Slimes and 100 Dumb Goblins
[/list]
[list]
[h2]Placeables Progression[/h2]
Placeables are now locked to progression. They still have a cost to place down.
[*] Furnace: Mine 25 Copper Ore to unlock.
[*] Pump: Have a Dwarf dig up 500 Water and 100 Lava.
[*] Crusher: Smelt 100 Copper Ingots and 10 Gold Ingots.
[*] Bottler: Smelt 1000 Glass.
[*] Fusion: Crush 200 Crushed Coal, 100 Crushed Copper, 50 Crushed Gold and 12 Crushed Diamond.
[*] Stamper: Smelt 15000 Copper Ingots and 5000 Gold Ingots.
[*] The Surface placeables do not require progression to unlock.
[/list]
[list]
[h1]Fixes[/h1]
[*] Fixed Dwarf Near window not showing correct floor number.
[/list]

Points are global, removed certain points, Materials will show all the time and Perks have been removed. I removed specific points to reduce the amount of non-material currencies so there's no more confusion what does what. notes.title: Dwarf News #12 - 1.0 Release and HUGE Changes
notes.notes:
Hello wild adventurers! Today I'll be showing you what was changed and what's being worked on. I don't want to spoil it all so I'll go over the need-to-know stuff so your brain can become excited. Everything is being worked on HARD and that being said, it has set us back another month or so -- BUT, that's a good thing! Allows us to work everything out and get it ready.

[h1]Feedback Assessment[/h1]
I have listened to feedback and suggestions with negative reviews, Discord community and other messages people have written. I cannot cater to everybody's needs; otherwise, the game would end up in a displeasing mess. HOWEVER, I do agree with some points people made and I've tried my best to balance the two.

I'll be going over what my thoughts are on the feedback below on the CURRENT game's gameplay status.

[h3]"Game is too slow", "Tiles have too much Health", "Barebones, too early in development"[/h3]
[list]
[*] Tile Health was high pretty high and there was no real defining concept with how Tile Health was overall. It was just a value and Dwarves had to mine until the Tile was mined and that's what made it slow.
[*] As for the game being "too Barebones", I have to disagree if you only played for 30 minutes, you're not going to unlock much. There's plenty of things to work toward and unlock. But, with the Tile Health being high at the start, most were discouraged due to how slow progression was.
[*] The game's concept before was to start with a couple Dwarves, they gain Entity Points, you spend those in the Dwarven Book and they'll earn more Experience Gain, Hit Damage, Hit Speed, etc. depending where you put your points into.
[*] I also feel as if a lot of people don't understand the Dwarven Book and perks very well either. There is a lot to understand and a lot has changed to make it easier, fun and more involved. That is where I think a lot of people were discouraged to continue on, especially the Tile Health situation. The guide wasn't completely finished until now, so most of my fault for not explaining more, but I didn't want to finish the guide when adding more content since I redid the whole entire guide system on 1.0.
[/list]

For interaction with Litty Game developers and our community please join our [url=https://discord.com/invite/R5NkCDu6Uy]Discord[/url]. We're open to constructive criticism, feedback and suggestions for our games and we find it very important to hear our community out!

If you don't have Discord, you can post your suggestions in the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2220570/discussions/4/]Suggestions Forum[/url].

I don't want to spoil everything, but I do want to show you that things have changed.. a lot!

[*] Removed Informational Button and added Tooltips. The guide also takes care of helping too now!
[*] Placeables (Furnace, Crusher, Fusion, Pump, Bottler, etc.) are no longer perks and they are always unlocked, but now they cost materials to place down. You can view them all in the Placeable Build Panel by clicking a ground tile.
[*] Workbench has been removed. With the new additions and changes, Workbench is redundant.
[*] There's now more tooltips in places that needed it. E.g. Archaeology and when adding fuel to placeables or trying to view a recipe.
[/list]
[list]
[h2]Perks and Points[/h2]
[*] Entity Points are now global, merged with all your floors and they were renamed to Dwarf Points. I felt like Entity Points wasn't obvious enough so I decided to rename it to something that makes more sense.
[*] Area Points were removed.
[*] Floor Points were removed.
[*] Floor Resets Counter were removed.
[*] Perks no longer exist.
[/list]

I wanted to reduce the amount of UI navigation. With removing a lot of Dwarven Book's navigating -- points are global, removed certain points, Materials will show all the time and Perks have been removed.

I removed specific points to reduce the amount of non-material currencies so there's no more confusion what does what. There might've been too many "point" additions that could have been removed early on.

[list]
[h2]Major Dwarven Book Changes[/h2]
[*] Dwarven Book was completely reworked and it's used for spending Dwarf Points.
[*] Materials are no longer in the Dwarven Book and are now shown on the main Canvas.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43209080/ecb5c899f070a5d1bf950d6636f8700de2ef36de.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43209080/8950dc30176288a242ae895810ff4d8603ab7df2.png[/img]
[/list]

[*] Dwarves can no longer be clicked to regenerate Stamina faster.
[*] Dwarves will no longer walk to chase enemies or the next area, or to catch up to the next area. Check World Generation Changes below for more info.

[h1]Final Thoughts[/h1]
Thank you everyone for the feedback! No matter harsh or constructive it is, we'll find ways to listen and work around what every player is running in to and/or feeling. This is going to be a huge update, so bear with us and I hope all of you understand!

Now, we're pretty slim on capital. I don't want to end up "half-making" The Surface. All of that grinding just to climb to lack of content and less content. We're going to be using some assets that will allow us to continue this update as planned, but it might not be as we wrote it out to be. Artists are very expensive. That being said, we're going to be working more on the concept to try and utilize more in-game resources so you feel like, for example, any ingots are worth being created.
[h2]Our plans for The Surface (WIP)[/h2]
[*] Trees, sky, different backgrounds to make it seem like you aren't in a cave anymore. This will be a transition from underneath leading to the top.
[*] New Enemies above ground only.
[*] New Dwarf Behavior: Explore
[*] The Surface Trader (must explore and find the trader).
[*] New Ore: Mithril. This can only be spawned when lightning hits the ground. Mithril is very valuable.
[*] The Surface will have a limited amount of Areas.
[/list]

[list]
[h2]Offline Progression[/h2]
Credits was a temporary solution, but not a good one. We'll still keep it in the game, but there is offline progression in the works. Offline Progression is pretty important when it comes to idlers, and we surely know this!
Dwarves must have a behavior and if they're mining the Floor would need to have Auto Reset toggled.
[*] Gain Area, Entity and Floor points while offline.
[*] Gain Materials while offline.
[*] Placeables such as Furnace, Crusher, etc will under-go some work with offline progression.
[/list]

[list]
[h2]Material Conversion[/h2]
[b]Trader Mechanic[/b]: This will be a work in progress but we want utilization of your resources towards end-game. You will be able to convert materials into other materials based on a Tier System. This Tier system will see the quality of what you're trying to convert and base its Tier on the Tier of the material you want those materials to convert to.
[/list]

[list]
[h2]New Placeable: Stamper[/h2]
Stampers will be used to create coins. Coins will be used for the Trader.
[*] 4 Gold Ingots to create 1 Gold Coin.
[*] 2 Copper Ingots to create 1 Copper Coin.
[/list]

[list]
[h2]Fusion Machine Recipes and Mechanics[/h2]
Fusion Machine creates Hardened Dust that allows you to boost fuel in placeables (Furnace, Crusher, Fusion, etc). It's currently implemented but the item cannot be used just yet. However, we're working on it!
[/list]

[list]
[h2]More Achievements[/h2]
Yes, there will be more achievements! We were going to release some more last Major Update but I ended up waiting until this upcoming major update. That way we can get all the necessary achievements implemented.
[/list]

[list]
[h2]There's More![/h2]
These are some of the things we're working on. We have more ideas, don't worry!
[/list]

[h1]What's Next?[/h1]
After our 1.0 release we're always open for new suggestions from our community. Please take the time to join our [url=https://discord.com/invite/R5NkCDu6Uy]Discord[/url] and suggest away! That being said, we will be taking a break (not from bug fixes, but new content) from Dwarves Mining Idle to focus more on our other projects. When we have more time and ideas for Dwarves Mining Idle, we surely will update it after our 1.0 release.

I haven't created a system like this and I want to at least try.

Addressing all of the above on What's Next is important before continuing to The Surface. I want all the previous content to be implemented fully and/or polished.

notes.title: Dwarf Weekend News #10 - Upcoming Major Update
notes.notes:
Hello fellow Dwarf grinders out there. I know it has been a good awhile, but rest assured we're always working on the game at a nice pace! Our next major update is Skill & Prestige; however, this update is much more than just that. Let's dive in, shall we?!

For interaction with Litty Game developers and our community please join our [url=https://discord.com/invite/R5NkCDu6Uy]Discord[/url]. We're open to constructive criticism, feedback and suggestions for our games and we find it very important to hear our community out!

[h1]Skill & Prestige[/h1]
After my last teaser there has been quite a lot done. The skills user interface is finished, but we are still waiting for some icons to be made.

[h2]Skill Tree[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43209080/8eda11113f4bdb92ad59ee59fb7299038d2a31a9.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43209080/adea4b10ef8a26032ef3c0df2ff425f1650c5dc6.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43209080/e64656c43c659948f80db21c0a653545d3ffb2fd.png[/img]

The last icons in the end screenshot are still being created so they'll be updated soon enough.

With this new Skill & Prestige system you'll be able to build Dwarves how you want with slight benefits from the trees themselves. 1 skill point is 10,000 experience. Spending a skill point removes experience from a Dwarf. Each time you spend a skill point it increases the cost by 1 for other skills in that tree.

As for prestige: After fully unlocking all the skills within a skill tree that Dwarf will be eligible for unlocking the prestige skill. A Dwarf will be able to prestige at level 10k and increases by 10k levels each time you prestige that specific Dwarf. Each Prestige increases experience gain by 25%.

[h1]Major Changes[/h1]
As we're getting closer and closer to The Surface on the roadmap, I wanted to switch up the road map and switch The Surface with game polishing first. But, I have not forgotten about the importance of The Surface.

[h2]The Surface[/h2]
You can now start climbing to The Surface. Only climbing to The Surface is being implemented at this time. The artwork has to be made for it; however, you will have time to work on The Climb grind beforehand. Don't forget that enemies drop wood which you'll need for the climb!

What was added?
Floor 1 is the climb floor. You will see a Wood icon with the cost text below the icon. Clicking this will prompt you with the requirements to start climbing.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43209080/7f2b8f2b6ad4963e5c68dba2cad07a4d36814403.png[/img]

[h2]Visual updates[/h2]
Some new visuals have been added to make the game less boring to the naked eye. I'll let you see that when we release as a surprise! I want to make Dwarves Mining Idle a bit more visually appealing VFX-wise. Nothing super intensive but enough to make you go, "Woah..."

[h2]Dwarf and AI Updates/Rework[/h2]
Dwarves behavior and animations are at a rough scale at the moment. After releasing Dwarves Mining Idle in early access there were changes to Dwarf AI at the beginning. That being said, we need to change them again for the better.

[h3]Dwarf Animations[/h3]
The way animations work is too much like a spider-web. Animations won't over-play when Dwarves need to work, nor will they play before a Dwarf starts moving (e.g. If you set Dwarf to combat they'll hit the air before moving, they won't anymore). This has been a long time coming after initially fixing the animations incorrectly playing frame by frame.

[h3]Dwarf Behavior[/h3]
I've noticed some users not finding out how to change Dwarf behaviors as a new player. I want to change that. Behaviors has been taken out of "View Stats" and put within the Dwarves Window. The idea is to assign your wanted behaviors to a Dwarf. For example, if I assign Mining first and Combat second; if there's nothing else to mine the Dwarf will then change their behavior to Combat. Top is highest priority whilst bottom is lowest priority. This will make it so your Dwarves are ALWAYS active depending on the behaviors you give them.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43209080/e9d2761b1fe84fad476eff878130127252244260.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43209080/09b496e9030f7cc75d146f8bdbc11beb6b8f704e.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43209080/b2a75f515eadc68d7cc8870b9397168466cdbae2.png[/img]

[h3]Dwarf Looting Update[/h3]
The way the Dwarves were finding loot was a bit rough and didn't help due to distance. Now, Dwarves that are looting will actually loot the closest items to them.

[h3]Enemy Rework[/h3]
Enemy armor and health aren't properly setup. How so? Dwarves can practically one-shot enemies. In this update we'll be addressing that.

[h2]Optimizations[/h2]
This update will include some internal optimizations. Though, you might not notice any major issues with performance, we're digging deep to make sure everything is okay! Within this major update, optimizations have been made and everything is working nicely!

There's some more updates but I think we've gone over enough! I want to try and release the update this upcoming Friday, but it isn't final. Still a bit more to do since it's a big major update!


Thanks for reading and I hope you have a great week! Again, please join our [url=https://discord.com/invite/R5NkCDu6Uy]Discord[/url] if you have any questions or want to be apart of our community.

[*] Resetting a floor will now give the amount of ore, crushed ore or item loot inserted into a Furnace, Crusher, etc. back to your materials.
[*] Fixed a placeable objects list not clearing after a floor reset. This caused a UI error when trying to access Floors & Areas window.
[/list]
[list]
[h3][b]Placeables[/b][/h3]
[*] Fixed certain materials having a negative value. This only happened if you tried to use a fuel source with a material that you didn't have.

[h2]UI[/h2]
[list]
[h3][b]General[/b][/h3]
[*] Fixed when clicking in an open window you can click behind that UI window.
[/list]
[list]
[h3][b]Settings Window[/b][/h3]
[*] Fixed when unmuting audio it wouldn't uncheck 'Muteall'. It will now unmute everything once you change audio if mute all was selected.
[/list]
[list]
[h3][b]Dwarves Window[/b][/h3]
[*] Status Text will no longer update if the Dwarves window is closed. This was a potential performance issue.
[*] Fixed Floor 2 always being selected by default when opening the Dwarves Window. It will now select Floor 1 by default.
[/list]
[list]
[h3][b]Dwarven Book[/b][/h3]
[*] Fixed constant refresh for perks after a new area was created if the Dwarven Book is open. It will now check if newly unlocked perks aren't showing then refresh the tab you have selected.
[*] Fixed Standard Notation format causing a text overlap. It will now only show an integer value instead returning double.
[*] Fixed certain perks taking materials before checking if you have all the materials required to purchase that perk. It will now properly check for all of those materials without taking anything unless you CAN unlock it.
[/list]
[h2]AI[/h2]
[list]
[h3][b]Dwarf[/b][/h3]
[*] Fixed Dwarves y offset due to destination. Dwarves should no longer be at an offset when they load in the game. This was happening when their default destination wasn't anything but 0.
[*] Fixed idle animation not playing when dwarves are idle.
[*] Fixed Dwarves hitting air when there's nothing else to mine.
[*] Fixed Combat Damage returning -1. It wasn't properly implemented. The points spent in Combat Hit Damage should calculate based on how many points you put in to Combat Hit Damage perk.
[*] Fixed Combat Hit Speed returning incorrect value and assigning an incorrect value when upgraded.
[/list]
[list]
[h3][b]Reset Door[/b][/h3]
[*] Fixed Reset Door decide window not showing on game load and when the Reset Door spawns.
[*] Fixed an error when the Reset Door loaded and it tried to set its toggle value when it didn't exist.
[/list]
[h1]What's Next?[/h1]
[list]
[*]Not every suggestion was in this update as I wanted it to be. From suggestions, I'll be adding a zoom out feature, destroying placeables and more information regarding how the game works in a whole (mostly Dwarven Book rework -- see below). I will also be looking into spawning areas in a 'dark' immersive way seeing most people suggested this -- we'll see how it impacts performance down the road if implemented.
[*] Dig mechanic so you're able to farm water and lava. It was supposed to be this update but I need to finish implementing the animations.
[*] Looting animations
[*] Placeables Quality of Life because they are very basic right now and need to show more valuable information. This will include destroying placeables and Dwarf selection to be more obvious (for example, telling the different between dwarves in a workbench, etc).
[*] Dwarven Book overhaul. Currently it's okay for now, but I want to make it more user-friendly.
[*] Pump and Pipes update. Dig mechanic is the default way until you can unlock a better way, and Pump and Pipes update will be the 'better' way to farm water and lava.
[*] More Store buy options. Right now there's 3 basic things to purchase.
[*] Add the different cosmetics. However, I'm thinking of adding special abilities to these to make some cosmetics and some special upgrades. It's a work-in-progress at the moment.
[/list]

notes.notes:
It's time for an update on what we're doing! This was supposed to be posted yesterday as an end of the week, beginning of a new week thing, but there was a lot of editing happening.

[h2]A Big Thank You[/h2]

First off, I would like to say thank you to all who has wishlisted our game. It feels good! That being said every week we're going to try and post a news update. This way all of you are still in the loop and don't feel discouraged about us and how we operate.

[h1]Update #1[/h1]
In this update we've hired a sound artist for in-game sounds and GFX artist for the Store Page and our company logo. With new sound additions, I've also been doing optimizations and a bit more polishing to the audio for a better experience!

Side note: I forgot all about adding the different Dwarf body types. This was supposed to be added before store page went public. I do apologize! This has been added and in the video below you can see all the new additions!

I most definitely believe in first impressions and I'm trying to deliver on them!

[h2]Sound[/h2]

[list]
[b]Additions[/b]
[*] Added Dwarf Walking Sound
[*] Added Dwarf Mining Sound. There's four unique sounds for both soft materials and hard materials.
[*] Added Dwarf Attack Hit Sound.
[*] Sounds created for: Background Music, Furnace, Crusher, Fusion Machine and enemy hit. These are still in the works but they're in!

[b]In-Game Audio[/b]
Let's face it. I've muted idler sounds because they aren't needed, right? Or just plain annoying. To counter this annoyance I'm looking for ways to make it.. well, not annoying.
[*] When Dwarves are out of camera view it will lower the audio. If far away it will mute the audio for that Entity. More updates to this in the future.
[/list]

[h2]Optimizations[/h2]
These weren't a major issue, nor a big impact on gameplay. I wanted to polish this so everybody can have a great experience when progressing further.

[/list]

[*] Fixed Dwarves causing lag due to their collision. This lag was tested with a lot of dwarves in the game to see how performance would do.
